name: Nerida Peart
biography: Nerida is our Assistant Minister, with a focus on children’s ministry and the 5pm Service. She has worked in churches in Vancouver and in the Hills District of Sydney. She is passionate about helping people integrate their faith into their whole life, so they can live flourishing lives for Jesus. She loves teaching on vocation, work, and sabbath.

She studied theology at Regent College, Vancouver with a minor in snowboarding at Whistler. She loves meeting people and hearing their stories. She loves the beach, reading novels and drinking coffee - sometimes all at the same time!  Nerida is married to Angus and they have three wonderful children.
